wargearItems.name: Biomechanical Masterworks
effects: This upgrade can only be taken by your Warlord. This model:
Increases its Movement characteristic by 2"
Increases its Weapons Skill by 2
Increases its Ballistics Skill by 2
Increases its Initiative characteristic by 2
Increases its Strength characteristic by 2
Increases its Toughness characteristic by 1
Increases its Wounds characteristic by 3
Gains the Feel No Pain 5+ ability
Must have a base greater than 60mm

  • Increases its Ballistics Skill by 2
  • Increases its Initiative characteristic by 2
  • Increases its Strength characteristic by 2
  • Increases its Toughness characteristic by 1
  • Increases its Wounds characteristic by 3
  • Gains the Feel No Pain 5+ ability
  • Must have a base greater than 60mm

wargearItems.name: Microvoid Shield Generator
effects: The bearer gains the Invulnerable Save 5+ ability.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: The bearer gains the Invulnerable Save 5+ ability.

wargearItems.name: Servitor Auto-Proxy
effects: Allows Servitor models in a unit being led by a Techpriest to benefit from the Doctrina Imperative activated by that Techpriest for the Battle Round.
Expands Doctrina Imperative range for Skitarii units from 6" to 12"
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
• Allows Servitor models in a unit being led by a Techpriest to benefit from the Doctrina Imperative activated by that Techpriest for the Battle Round.
  • Expands Doctrina Imperative range for Skitarii units from 6" to 12"

wargearItems.name: Techno-Kit
effects: During the Command Phase, Return Up to D3 models that were destroyed during the last Battle Round
Each model must first pass a Battle Shock Test before it can be returned to the battlefield. If it fails, the model is permanently destroyed for the remainder of the battle.
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
• During the Command Phase, Return Up to D3 models that were destroyed during the last Battle Round
  • Each model must first pass a Battle Shock Test before it can be returned to the battlefield. If it fails, the model is permanently destroyed for the remainder of the battle.

wargearItems.name: Breacher Plate
effects: Increase Armour Save characteristic to 2+
Increase Wounds characteristic by 2
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
• Increase Armour Save characteristic to 2+
  • Increase Wounds characteristic by 2

wargearItems.name: Enhanced Data-Tether
effects: Allows Skitarii Infantry units to be treated as in range for a Doctrina Imperative when they are within 6" of another Skitarii Infantry unit that is within Doctrina Imperative range, even if no models in the bearer's unit are within 6" of a Techpriest Leader.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: Allows Skitarii Infantry units to be treated as in range for a Doctrina Imperative when they are within 6" of another Skitarii Infantry unit that is within Doctrina Imperative range, even if no models in the bearer's unit are within 6" of a Techpriest Leader.

wargearItems.name: Broad Spectrum Data-Tether
effects: Allows Skitarii Vehicle models to be treated as in range for a Doctrina Imperative when they are within 12" of another Skitarii unit that is within Doctrina Imperative range, even if no models in the bearer's unit are within 6" of a Techpriest Leader.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: Allows Skitarii Vehicle models to be treated as in range for a Doctrina Imperative when they are within 12" of another Skitarii unit that is within Doctrina Imperative range, even if no models in the bearer's unit are within 6" of a Techpriest Leader.

wargearItems.name: Omnispex
effects: While the bearer is on the battlefield, enemy units cannot place models within 12" of the bearer's unit when using the Enter the Battlefield from Strategic Reserves Action.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: While the bearer is on the battlefield, enemy units cannot place models within 12" of the bearer's unit when using the Enter the Battlefield from Strategic Reserves Action.

wargearItems.name: Auto-proxy
effects: While the bearer is on the battlefield, the bearer's unit can benefit from the Doctrina Imperatives Army Rule.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: While the bearer is on the battlefield, the bearer's unit can benefit from the Doctrina Imperatives Army Rule.

wargearItems.name: Twin-linked
effects: Weapon gains the Twin-linked ability:
For weapons or Weapon Attack Profiles with a Strength characteristic of 7 or less, increase the Attacks characteristic by 3
For weapons or Weapon Attack Profiles with a Strength characteristic of 8 or more, increase the Attacks characteristic by 1
The Twin-Linked upgrade doubles the points cost of the weapon being upgraded.
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
Weapon gains the Twin-linked ability:

  • For weapons or Weapon Attack Profiles with a Strength characteristic of 7 or less, increase the Attacks characteristic by 3
  • For weapons or Weapon Attack Profiles with a Strength characteristic of 8 or more, increase the Attacks characteristic by 1

The Twin-Linked upgrade doubles the points cost of the weapon being upgraded.

wargearItems.name: Smoke Launchers
effects: The bearer can make 2 attacks with Smoke Grenades as part of a Shoot action.
